decisions.reason: As a flagship shown on the home page and central to the announced enterprise messaging direction, the firm is heavily and publicly committed to transactional email and will persist with it.
Managed Capture Services has its own page and a reported customer adoption, supports the electronic document workflow direction, and builds on substantial investment, so dropping it is unlikely.
Email-to-fax conversion builds on the firm's core fax and messaging infrastructure at low incremental cost and serves regulated customers, so the firm keeps it even though it is promoted less.
The fax delivery optimization feature is closely tied to the established fax service and costs little to maintain, though it could be quietly folded into the base offering.
Sandbox threat protection is integral to the security portfolio that customers in regulated processes demand, and the firm has invested in it as part of its secure messaging positioning.
